design.intent: Teach curved takeoff, show the explosive connector and loop, then give the player a safe ground return.

sequence.purpose: Clear runway; show the first lesson before commitment.
Establish stable pumping before curved takeoff.
Teach leaning into a smooth rising curve and matching the catch.
Bring the halo into view and settle at its entry elevation.
Commit to the optional connector, boost into inversion, then land on the revealed fallback.
Let suspension and camera settle after the loop return.
Offer an elevated reward line with safe ground underneath.
A small final skip echoes the opening scoop without another inversion.
Empty finish release after the last challenge.
